notes: §1985:X.5.3.3 SR2: 'Identifier-1 must reference an alphanumeric data item.' CallBinder.BindCancel screens each data-reference target through NameTargetRefusal (category alphanumeric or national, by ItemCategory) and each function-identifier through OperandTargetRefusal (its function category), reporting COBOL1696; the 2023 national widening is unreachable at 85 because national items and N literals are themselves COBOL0900. Probes at --std 85: (b/d) PIC 9(4) (the witness), a numeric 05 inside a group, PIC A(4) alphabetic, PIC XXXBX alphanumeric-edited and USAGE INDEX each COBOL1696, FUNCTION LENGTH (integer) COBOL1696; accepted: a JUSTIFIED RIGHT PIC X(4), an alphanumeric group (holding a numeric item), FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE(1:4); (a) WS-JX(1:WS-CNT + 1) cancelled SUBP, and an OCCURS DEPENDING group cancelled SUBP at length 4 ('SUBP') and named no program at length 3 ('SUB'), so SUBP kept its state (COUNT 1, COUNT 1, COUNT 2).

next.reason: 1985: "Identifier-1 must reference an alphanumeric data item."; 2023: "Identifier-1 shall be defined as an alphanumeric or national data item.". Same CANCEL identifier-1 rule, but 2023 adds national data items as allowed, so it accepts programs the 1985 rule refuses.
